title: AirPlay
description: Your iPhone's screen on the central display by AirPlay screen mirroring, parked only. Needs the jap-airplay-d tool.

id8.description: Your iPhone's screen on the iDrive 8 display by AirPlay screen mirroring, parked only: disconnect CarPlay, join the car's Wi-Fi, then Screen Mirroring and the car's name. The sound stays on Bluetooth. Needs the jap-airplay-d tool and the GPU renderer (mgu-render).
